thread:
marta: Heads-up: noticed a flaky failure in the JS helper that validates structured tool outputs when token refresh + retry kicks in. Seen it twice in the sample-app onboarding flow this week.

sam: Ugh. Any stack or repro?

marta: Short repro: trigger an auth refresh by forcing a 401 on first call, helper retries with new token, and the schema sanitizer ends up returning an empty tool object instead of the expected {name, args}. Happens only in streaming+structured mode.

alex: Can you paste the sanitized output that broke?

marta: Sure — messy, but here's the logged payload right after retry: 

```
{"tool": "search", "result": "{\"name\":\"search\", \"args\": \"{\\\"q\\\":\\\"runs\\\"}\"}"}
```

When the helper tries to parse it it treats result as a string and runs schema-check which expects an object. We end up returning {} which bubbles up to sample app UI as blank response.

ryan: Sounds like double-encoding during retry path. Maybe the earlier serializer runs before we replace the auth header? Or we re-serialize an already-stringified tool result.

sam: Could also be ordering: retry wrapper wraps the transport, but the sanitizer is attached as a response transform — if the response body was already JSON.stringified in a previous layer the transform sees a string.

marta: Exactly. I temporarily worked around it by adding a defensiveness check in the helper: if typeof field === 'string' try JSON.parse, else pass through. Quick patch here: 

```
if (typeof result === 'string') {
  try {
    result = JSON.parse(result);
  } catch (e) {
    // fall back, keep original
  }
}
// run schema.validate(result)
```

alex: Good pragmatic fix. But we need to protect the canonical serializer so this doesn't keep cropping up. Could be parity issue between node and py SDKs too.

ryan: I'll add an integration test in sample-app that forces an auth retry + streaming tool result to catch regressions. Also file an issue to update the transport layer to avoid double-encoding.

sam: Can we add a shim at the transport boundary to normalize response bodies to objects where possible? That way helpers don't need to each guard.

marta: Prefer a single normalization in the SDK core. Helpers can keep a light guard as defensive programming, but SDK should guarantee stable types.

ci-bot: Created issue DEVEX-1121: "normalize/avoid double-encoding on retry path" and linked PR template.

alex: Action list: (1) ryan adds integration test + sample-app PR, (2) transport normalization spike in SDK (assign to sam), (3) helper patch landed as short-term fix (marta PR), (4) update onboarding README to call out known workaround.

marta: I'll open the helper PR now. Small note: include test that simulates 401 then 200 with stringified payload so we don't miss it.

ryan: Pushed test to branch, CI failing on lint — will fix and open draft PR.

sam: I'll start a quick spike to find the codepath that double-encodes during retry. If we can pinpoint it's likely a single line fix.

marta: Thanks all. Leaving the defensive parse in helper until we have core fix + tests.

alex: One more parity note: can someone check python SDK behavior? If py already normalizes we should document and sync.

ryan: I'll ask @olga on the python SDK thread and link here.

marta: TL;DR: flaky onboarding bug traced to double-encoding during auth retry, temporary guard added, infra tests + SDK normalization planned.

sam: Nice debugging, good call on adding a sample-app regression test. :thumbsup:

marta: filing follow-ups now, ping if you want to help review the patch.
